text:
ria (design): Pitched a compact dark-mode refresh for console panels + code snippets. Main ask: tighten palette so charts read at 1px and inline code doesn't disappear on older monitors.

noah (frontend): Seen the mock. The pale cream inline code is the issue. Also the axis labels at 11px get lost on monitors with warm gamma.

ria (design): Proposal: change inline code bg to #081217, inline border #12313a, text #cbeef6. Chart swatches: series A #5fd2b4, B #4f8fff, C #ffad62, D #c0b5ff.

claire (product): Series C for warnings? Works. Also change chart label from "95th perc" to "P95 latency" and add unit tooltip for embeddings (vectors vs tokens).

diego (eng): For small stroke widths add a 1px outer shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.18)) to improve separation. Also add an SVG pattern fallback for alert areas for color-blind users.

aria-bot: Accessibility scan queued: running contrast + colorblind diffs. ETA ~6m.

noah (frontend): Can you paste the vars so I can patch the theme switcher?

ria (design): Snippet:
:root[data-theme="dark"] { --bg:#061017; --surface:#0c1416; --text:#d2eaf2; --code-bg:#081217; --code-border:#12313a; --series-a:#5fd2b4; --series-b:#4f8fff; --series-c:#ffad62; --series-d:#c0b5ff; }

aria-bot: Report ready: flagged items -> (1) --text on .tiny-label fails 4.5:1, (2) series-b vs series-d low contrast at 1px, (3) inline code border needs 1px stronger.

ria (design): Action: tweak --text to #c9e6ee for tiny labels, bump code-border to #14404a, nudge series-d to #b8a8ff. I'll update mock and re-run.

noah (frontend): After update I'll run visual diffs and open PR. Ping me.

claire (product): Love the compactness. This should help dashboards that are token-dense.

diego (eng): I'll add pattern SVG and prefers-reduced-motion for chart glows.

ria (design): Thanks all. I'll push updated assets and a short release note: "Dark theme: tightened chart palette, improved inline code legibility, P95 copy polish."
